Chain-level campaign-v1 screen (identity_schema campaign-v1, scenario_id null), first run for this chain. Universe built per LINK across all 13 links, worked in priority order: the one money-corner link first (c2-and-sensor-fusion), then the two CHOKE_POINT links (counter-uas-funding-and-requirements, c2-and-sensor-fusion again), then the rest by chain position.

The mapping (data/mappings/offshore-counter-drone.json, 14 issuers, 21 placements) is status ACTIVE with no audit block at all (audit is null, never run), so it has no current PASS census audit and every row on this chain must rest on Ron's 2026-09-01 PLACEMENT-scope rule: audit_scope 'PLACEMENT' declared on the row, admitted only when the consumed placement's evidence is entirely VERIFIED.

THE FINDING THIS RUN PRODUCES: none of the mapping's 21 placements clear that bar. Every single placement on every one of the 13 links carries evidence tagged INFERRED and nothing else; zero placements anywhere in this mapping carry a VERIFIED evidence item. This is a uniform property of the whole census, not a per-link accident: rf-and-radar-front-end-components (RFHIC, INFERRED), maritime-detection-radar (HENSOLDT, LEONARDO, LEONARDO-DRS, all INFERRED), electro-optical-and-acoustic-sensing (HENSOLDT, TELEDYNE-TECHNOLOGIES, both INFERRED), rf-detection-and-jamming (RFHIC, DRONESHIELD, both INFERRED), subsea-and-underwater-sensing (KONGSBERG-GRUPPEN, TELEDYNE-TECHNOLOGIES, both INFERRED), c2-and-sensor-fusion [MONEY CORNER, CHOKE_POINT] (HENSOLDT, THALES, TELEDYNE-TECHNOLOGIES, KONGSBERG-GRUPPEN, all INFERRED), short-range-effectors (LEONARDO, INFERRED), reinsurance-and-lloyds-capacity (CHUBB, SWISS-RE, both INFERRED), offshore-war-and-property-underwriting (AXA, INFERRED), platform-integration-and-hardening (SAIPEM, INFERRED), offshore-energy-operator (OMV-PETROM, ROMGAZ, both INFERRED). counter-uas-funding-and-requirements and uncrewed-patrol-and-mcm-response carry zero placements by chain design (buyer-only alliance link and three sovereign navies respectively, per the chain's own map_limitation), not by mapping omission. Consequently this run seats zero rows on all 13 links. Every link is genuinely searched, and every link is genuinely empty, for the same single reason recorded once here rather than repeated 21 times.

c2-and-sensor-fusion [MONEY CORNER, CHOKE_POINT, verdict UNDISCOVERED]: searched and empty. This is the link this whole screen was built to clear first. It carries 4 placements: HENSOLDT, THALES and TELEDYNE-TECHNOLOGIES each already hold a COMPLETE O2 profile on disk and would pass every downstream check_screen.py gate (profile status, data_tier match, listing resolution) the moment their placement evidence includes one VERIFIED item; KONGSBERG-GRUPPEN is BLOCKED at O3 and would be refused regardless of evidence. So the money corner is not thin on candidates or on profiling work already done. It is blocked entirely on one mechanical fact: the mapping's role_evidence for this link, and for every link, is INFERRED (drawn from vendor blog posts, trade press and a NATO-adjacent news article, per the chain's own evidence blocks), never a VERIFIED primary source the placement author fetched and tagged as such. Fixing this money corner is a mapping-quality action (re-run universe research with VERIFIED-tagged primary sources, or a fresh-context universe-audit that PASSes the whole census on its current INFERRED evidence, which method section 6A ties to the census's OPEN/EXHAUSTED link_coverage rather than to evidence tags directly), not a screen action; Sieve does not write to data/mappings/.

No fundamentals, market, or EDGAR data was fetched for this run: the blocker here is a mapping-evidence property, not a missing market or filing figure, so no PENDING_DATA request rows were queued. Backlogged to Atlas: the offshore-counter-drone mapping needs either VERIFIED-tagged primary-source role evidence per placement (at minimum on c2-and-sensor-fusion, the money corner) or a fresh-context run universe-audit that resolves the census to COMPLETE, before this chain can produce a single strict screen row.

RE-RUN 2026-09-04 (same day, after commit 175a0a0): Atlas landed 4 fresh-context run universe-audit --placement audits on c2-and-sensor-fusion, the money corner: PASS for HENSOLDT, THALES and KONGSBERG-GRUPPEN (each placement's role claim and listing identity confirmed live against a freshly fetched primary source, record_digest bound to the exact placement content), FAIL for TELEDYNE-TECHNOLOGIES (the placement's role text asserts a 2026 SeaSEC critical-underwater-infrastructure exercise deployment that its sole cited evidence item, the October 2024 Cerberus XL unveiling article, does not support; that SeaSEC fact exists only in the chain link's own evidence, not in this placement's evidence list, so the placement oversells its citation). TELEDYNE-TECHNOLOGIES is excluded from this screen on that finding, independent of the evidence-tag question below.

This re-run tested whether the 3 PASS audits let HENSOLDT, THALES and KONGSBERG-GRUPPEN seat as rows and found they still cannot, for two separable reasons. First, KONGSBERG-GRUPPEN's profile (data/companies/KONGSBERG-GRUPPEN.json) remains status BLOCKED, opportunity_tier O3 as of today (fundamentals HTTP 404 on CIK 1535759, not re-queued, its own basis reads 'a companyfacts 404 on this foreign local listing means the vendor leg served nothing'): O3 profiles are refused as screen inputs regardless of placement evidence, per method 6 and the sieve-profiler contract. Second, and binding on all three including HENSOLDT and THALES (both COMPLETE O2 and otherwise admissible): `run universe-audit --placement` is advisory. Per the mapping's own changelog language ('this audit is advisory only per the placement-audit contract, and the author corrects the role text in a later run universe') and per CLAUDE.md's own wording ('A current PASS entry admits that issuer to `run deepdive`'), a PASS placement_audits[] entry writes only the audit record; it does not mutate the mapping's placements[].evidence[].tag. Every one of the four c2-and-sensor-fusion placements, PASS and FAIL alike, still carries `evidence: [{"tag": "INFERRED"}]` unchanged in the mapping's placements array. check_screen.py's PLACEMENT-scope admission rule (method 6: 'a row over an ACTIVE, un-audited mapping declares audit_scope PLACEMENT and rests on all-VERIFIED placement evidence') reads exactly that array, not placement_audits[], and was confirmed empirically against a draft HENSOLDT row in an isolated test root this run: it refuses with 'audit_scope PLACEMENT on an un-audited mapping requires every evidence item on the placement to be VERIFIED; INFERRED issuer-role evidence needs the census audit'. So the placement-audit clause in CLAUDE.md's `run universe-audit --placement` row, which names `run deepdive` as what a PASS entry admits, and method 6's screen PLACEMENT scope, which needs the raw evidence tag itself, are two different admission paths; a PASS placement audit is not a substitute for the evidence tag and does not by itself seat a screen row. This screen therefore seats 0 rows again this run, for a narrower and now precisely located reason than the first run's uniform INFERRED-evidence finding: c2-and-sensor-fusion specifically has 3 of 4 placements independently confirmed accurate by a fresh-context reviewer and still cannot seat, because nothing in the mapping-write or audit tooling promotes a PASSed placement's evidence tag from INFERRED to VERIFIED. Backlogged to Atlas: promote the evidence tag on the 3 PASSed c2-and-sensor-fusion placements (HENSOLDT, THALES, KONGSBERG-GRUPPEN) to VERIFIED in a later `run universe` amendment, citing the placement audit's own live-fetched source_excerpt as the VERIFIED evidence item; or, if Ron wants a PASS placement_audits[] entry to admit a screen row directly, that is a change to tools/check_screen.py's `_placement_admissible` (or to method 6's PLACEMENT-scope text), which Sieve escalates rather than applies.

RE-RUN 2026-09-06 (this run): tools/check_screen.py commit 5e5f3b5 now honours a current PASS placement_audits[] entry as an independent admission basis alongside the all-VERIFIED-evidence tag rule. Separately, and decisively, the census commit c37fa7b (run universe offshore-counter-drone, live re-fetch) promoted 13 of the mapping's 21 placements from INFERRED to VERIFIED evidence directly, including all 3 PASSed c2-and-sensor-fusion placements (HENSOLDT, THALES, KONGSBERG-GRUPPEN); commit 133a641 then re-verified those 3 placement audits as still current against the new evidence content and kept them PASS.
